item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Require a supplied source passage for every definition.","mechanism":"Enforce source linkage at the storage boundary.","implementation":"Create a supplied-passages registry. Require each definition’s source_passage_id to reference an existing registry entry. Reject missing or unknown IDs on every write path; provide no external-source lookup.","check":"Attempt to save definitions with absent, unknown, and valid passage IDs. Only the valid reference succeeds.","risk":"A valid reference proves linkage, not that the passage supports the wording."},{"action":"Store competing definitions without overwriting either wording.","mechanism":"Represent each wording as a separate definition attached to the same term.","implementation":"Give each alternative its own definition ID, exact wording, and required source passage ID. Make “Add competing wording” distinct from “Edit.” Preserve prior wording when edits occur.","check":"Add two conflicting definitions and edit one. Both alternatives and the edited definition’s previous wording remain inspectable with their source IDs.","risk":"Minor variants may accumulate; grouping must not silently merge their wording."},{"action":"Make each definition’s source directly inspectable.","mechanism":"Place source evidence beside the wording it supports.","implementation":"Add a “View passage” control to every definition. Open the complete supplied passage with its ID in an adjacent panel. If highlighting a supporting span, retain the unhighlighted surrounding passage.","check":"From each displayed alternative, open its exact stored passage without leaving the term. Verify the displayed text matches the stored passage.","risk":"A selected highlight can bias interpretation; readers must still see the complete passage."},{"action":"Record what is disputed, not just a disputed badge.","mechanism":"Attach explicit disagreement records to definition IDs.","implementation":"Provide a dispute form containing the challenged definition, objection, competing wording if present, and relevant supplied passage IDs. Store competing wording as a source-linked definition. Keep resolved objections visible with their resolution rationale.","check":"Create and resolve a dispute. A reader can still inspect the original objection, competing wording, source passages, and resolution.","risk":"Resolution may be mistaken for consensus; label it as an editorial decision."},{"action":"Prevent source corrections from silently changing a definition’s evidence.","mechanism":"Keep passage versions immutable and flag affected definitions.","implementation":"Treat a corrected passage as a new passage ID linked to its predecessor. Retain the old passage, flag definitions referencing it for review, and require an explicit relinking decision. Block deletion of referenced passages.","check":"Correct a passage used by two definitions. Both retain their original evidence and receive review flags; neither changes its reference automatically.","risk":"Review work can accumulate, so pending flags must remain visible."},{"action":"Separate different senses from competing wording.","mechanism":"Distinguish disagreement about one meaning from definitions describing different meanings.","implementation":"Allow an editor to group source-linked definitions into labeled senses. Require an explicit choice between “another sense” and “competing wording,” while permitting later reclassification without deleting definitions or disputes.","check":"Create two senses and a dispute within one. Readers can distinguish the senses and identify precisely which alternatives compete.","risk":"Sense splitting could conceal disagreement; preserve reclassification history and existing dispute links."},{"action":"Expose disagreement before readers open a term.","mechanism":"Carry disagreement status into glossary navigation.","implementation":"Show alternative counts and unresolved-dispute labels in term lists and search results. Add a disputed-terms filter. On term pages, show all alternatives without collapsing nonpreferred wording by default.","check":"For a term with two alternatives and an unresolved dispute, verify that lists, search results, the filter, and the term page expose that state.","risk":"Unlabeled counts may imply that every alternative is disputed; distinguish alternatives from active disputes."}],"abstention_reason":""}
